{{Quote|I am not the first Ozzel to rise within the naval ranks. Perhaps you have read of ''[&hellip;]'' Enos Ozzel who pushed the Cold Coil back into the Unknown Regions at the dawn of the Early Manderon Period.|Kendal Ozzel, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Cold Coil''' was an entity that originated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. At the start of the early [[Manderon Period]],<ref name="IH" /> which lasted between [[7000 BBY]] and [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Enos Ozzel]], a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and ancestor of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]<ref name="IH" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|433|Ozzel, Admiral Kendal}}</ref> [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], pushed the Cold Coil back into the Unknown Regions, a fact that Kendal, holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]], noted in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] manual published<ref name="IH" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' is presented as an [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|in-universe document]] published nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cold Coil was mentioned in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2014]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''.<ref name="IH" />
